_comment: ACME Manufacturing Inc. — a fictional calendar-2024 C corporation built to be keyed
into commercial tax software and compared line by line. See acme-2024.md.
* No foreign operations, no CFC, not publicly traded — nothing that would make
another package ask questions this one does not.
* Dividends come from a corporation less than 20% owned, so the DRD rate is the
50% default and no ownership slider has to be set.
* The asset was placed in service in 2022, so 2024 depreciation is pure MACRS
table with no first-year bonus election to disagree about.
* Average gross receipts are well under the §448(c) threshold, so §163(j) does
not apply and all interest stays deductible.
* §263A percentages are left at zero. Absorption is judgment-dependent and would
inject noise into a comparison meant to test the return skeleton.
